evals.question: Can I buy a daily multivitamin with my FSA?
evals.text: A daily multivitamin taken for general health is an eligible health FSA expense.

evals.question: Do I need a prescription to buy ibuprofen with my FSA?
evals.text: Over-the-counter pain relievers such as ibuprofen are eligible health FSA expenses without a prescription.

evals.question: Can I buy toothpaste with my FSA?
evals.text: Toothpaste is an eligible health FSA expense.
